kitDescription: Bay (Treasure) is a Fire-element rocket-launcher Defender with a Burst II skill on a 40-second cooldown, and her entire kit is survivability — she has no offensive line of any kind. When she uses her Burst Skill, all allies proportionally share incoming damage and gain DEF scaled off her own DEF, both persistently. Every full-charge shot she fires (and a rocket launcher's every shot is a full charge) heals all allies except herself for 4% of her Max HP. Her Skill 2 shares damage onto her cover, regenerates cover HP for 5 seconds when Full Burst ends, and heals her for 20% Max HP when entering Burst Stage 1 with her cover destroyed. Her Burst rebuilds a destroyed cover once per battle, raises her cover's Max HP for 20 seconds, and reduces all allies' damage taken by 8.87% for 10 seconds.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. All nine kit lines are FAITHFUL (the S1 DEF grant with a documented, observably-inert semantic approximation; the S1 full-charge ally heal keyed to chargeCounter count:1) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (all seven defensive/cover lines verbatim in unmodeled with correct rejection of the three pre-registered traps: damageTakenPct mis-keying, cover-HoT-as-heal, cover-Max-HP-as-unit-Max-HP). Convergence is GREEN in substance: the S5 suite's sole RED is a structural strictness artifact (shotFired vs chargeCounter count:1) whose every behavioral counterpart passed against the driver, and chargeCounter is the more literal encoding of 'Full Charge attacks' since it only advances on full charges — the S5/S6 shotFired preference would actually over-fire on any hypothetical partial-charge release. The S6 cover-HoT-as-self-heal divergence is spurious (driver + S2b + the marciana precedent agree it must not emit recovery events; ruled against S6, not the driver). Discrimination is live: the driver's tests prove the per-shot cadence against fullBurstEnter/stripped counterfactuals via the asuka sole-consumer fixture, prove defPct inertness against a defAsDamage counterfactual that moves totals, and pin the damageTakenPct negative assertion; S5 independently proves non-vacuity (the mis-encoded 8.87% boss debuff would move team damage). For GO nothing must change. Same-model residual the owner should spot-check: (1) the defPct caster-vs-target approximation is inert only because v1 has no DEF→damage path — if a defensive or conversion consumer ever lands, this line must be revisited first; (2) the chargeCounter/shotFired equivalence rests on the sim.ts claim that every RL dump dispatches charged=true — one focus-video cadence read (rounds/min + reload gap, already ⚑-flagged in the driver's caveats) would close it; (3) Bay never bursting in crown-shared-B2 fixtures was handled correctly by both blind suites via sole-B2 comps, but any future Bay fixture reuse should re-verify the burst-cast non-vacuity marker.
